calculation.description: Ranks assets for short-term reversal by negating their five-day return and normalizing by 20-day realized daily volatility scaled to a five-day horizon, with a small stabilizer. Higher values indicate stronger reversal potential per unit of recent risk.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.039244), 2023-2024 (+0.016396), and 2025-2027 (+0.030093). Five-day predictive power weakened and ten-day decay turned negative; use as a short-horizon diversified sleeve.
